records.name: Psychic Fighter
records.description:
Made her
hands glow
because dark
streets scare
her.
records.zdescription:
Rumor says
she just rubs
glowing
powder on
them.

records.name: Paper Sack
records.description:
Can't breathe
when it gets
wet.
records.zdescription:
Caves in
every time he
breathes.

records.name: Half-Dragon
records.description:
Leaves scales
around the
room as she
walks.
records.zdescription:
Her hobby is
decorating
her room with
shed scales.

records.name: Luchador
records.description:
Doesn't take
off the mask
even to
sleep.
records.zdescription:
The mask
smells a
little...
questionable.

records.name: Knight Wolf
records.description:
Prides
himself on
being a very
rare knight.
records.zdescription:
Loses some
fur when it
rubs against
the armor.

records.name: Sand Goblin
records.description:
Tries to keep
his pranks
just barely
harmless.
records.zdescription:
His pranks
are no longer
harmless.

records.name: Invisible
records.description:
People often
call him
mysterious.
records.zdescription:
At the age
where he
wants people
to notice
him.

records.name: Michael
records.description:
Solves even
headaches
with angelic
power.
records.zdescription:
Wants to use
angelic power
to taste
every brain
in the world.

records.name: Mikhail
records.description:
Came down
from heaven
and now can't
be bothered
to go back.
records.zdescription:
Even as a
zombie, his
angelic
radiance
hasn't faded.

records.name: Michelle
records.description:
Still an
active angel,
even in old
age.
records.zdescription:
Doesn't mind
being asked
if he used to
be a
musician.

records.name: Mike
records.description:
Pranked so
much his
angel robes
got
confiscated.
records.zdescription:
Can't get
going without
his angel
robes, so he
eats brains.

records.name: Special Forces Echo
records.description:
Here to seize
the cafe.
records.zdescription:
A true
professional
during raids.

records.name: Special Forces Foxtrot
records.description:
Enjoys his
meal
remembering
his harsh
training.
records.zdescription:
Realized his
harsh
training was
all for
eating
brains.

records.name: Special Forces Golf
records.description:
Can't wait
for a gas
mask that
covers his
whole head.
records.zdescription:
Even as a
zombie, don't
mention his
hair.

records.name: Special Forces Hotel
records.description:
There are so
many weapons
he wants.
records.zdescription:
Uses
camouflage to
sneak off
with brains.

records.name: Unicorn Head
records.description:
Rules the
world with a
thrust of his
horn.
records.zdescription:
His horn
stabs his
knee when he
bows too
deeply.

records.name: Cockatrice Head
records.description:
Proud of his
bright red
comb.
records.zdescription:
Shudders at
the dish
"devil-style
chicken."

records.name: Griffin Head
records.description:
Proud of his
sharp beak.
records.zdescription:
His beak
makes brains
easy to eat.

records.name: Hawk Head
records.description:
Sadly, he
can't fly.
records.zdescription:
As a zombie,
he doesn't
care that he
can't fly.

records.name: Mackerel Salaryman
records.description:
Nobody beats
him for
freshness.
records.zdescription:
Wants to stay
a fresh fish,
even as a
zombie.

records.name: Middle-Aged Sunfish
records.description:
Learned the
importance of
living with
his chin up.
records.zdescription:
Came up with
the pun
"rotten but
still
kickin'."

records.name: Anglerfish Gentleman
records.description:
Wishes his
head were a
little
slimmer.
records.zdescription:
His favorite
food is
brains of
fish smaller
than him.

records.name: Fish Skeleton
records.description:
People think
his body got
eaten, but he
was born like
this.
records.zdescription:
Where the
brains go
after he eats
them is a
mystery.

records.name: Tin Robot Vermilion
records.description:
The weight of
his head
often tips
him sideways.
records.zdescription:
Came up with
a lamp that
lights up
when he spots
a tasty
brain.

records.name: Tin Robot Indigo
records.description:
Generously
wears a tin
robot worth a
small fortune
on his head.
records.zdescription:
Raids enemies
carefully so
he doesn't
break his
head parts.

records.name: Tin Robot Spring Green
records.description:
Realized his
stiff
shoulders
come from his
heavy head.
records.zdescription:
Feels a
little faster
after winding
his key.

records.name: Wind-Up Robot
records.description:
Has never
lost a
headbutt.
records.zdescription:
Eating brains
keeps his
screws nice
and tight.

records.name: Block 1 Ghost
records.description:
Former cafe
worker. On
the Block 1
footbridge...
records.zdescription:
Slips through
anything, so
brain hunting
is easy.

records.name: Block 2 Ghost
records.description:
Former
salaryman. At
the Block 2 i
ntersection..
.
records.zdescription:
A working
man, so ghost
or zombie,
the tie stays
on.

records.name: Block 3 Ghost
records.description:
Former
musician. At
the Block 3
crosswalk...
records.zdescription:
A master of
spooky
"woooOOOooo"
rhythms.

records.name: Ghostaro
records.description:
Caught a cold
from a chilly
scalp, and
then...
records.zdescription:
Thanks to his
halo, at
least his
head
survived.

records.name: Card Soldier Diamonds
records.description:
Ace of the
Diamond clan.
Proudly
guards the
castle.
records.zdescription:
Forget
guarding the
castle, he
wants brains.

records.name: Card Soldier Clubs
records.description:
Headbutting's
stronger, but
he uses a
spear so he
won't break
it.
records.zdescription:
His club hat
can hold 3
brains.

records.name: Card Soldier Hearts
records.description:
A kind
soldier who
takes his
family to
cafes on his
days off.
records.zdescription:
Usually
gentle, but
his eyes
change when
he spots a
fresh brain.

records.name: Card Soldier Spades
records.description:
His card body
is super
hard, so his
defense is
great.
records.zdescription:
Wonders if he
can flip open
his card to
store brains.

records.name: Card Skeleton
records.description:
Wants to earn
his mark and
wear it on
his head
someday.
records.zdescription:
I'm not
bald... I was
born like
this,
seriously,
I'm NOT
bald...

records.name: Stabby Nurse
records.description:
Accidentally
drops
syringes into
patients.
records.zdescription:
Wants to be
gentle, but
keeps hunting
for veins
with the
needle.

records.name: Stompy Nurse
records.description:
Accidentally
steps on
important
tubes and
hurts
patients.
records.zdescription:
Always tries
to smile, but
always steps
on important
tubes.

records.name: Slashy Nurse
records.description:
Accidentally
slips handing
over the
scalpel and
cuts
patients.
records.zdescription:
Tries not to
repeat
mistakes, but
always drops
the scalpel.

records.name: Bitey Nurse
records.description:
Her specialty
is ripping
bandages with
her teeth.
records.zdescription:
The best time
to bite is
when patients
look happy
and healthy.

records.name: Red Riding Hood
records.description:
Taking a cafe
break before
going to find
Grandma.
records.zdescription:
Wants to pack
brains in her
basket as a
souvenir.

records.name: White Riding Hood
records.description:
Annoyed that
everyone
assumes
riding hoods
have to be
red.
records.zdescription:
Devours
brains while
the spatter
dyes her hood
red.

records.name: Black Riding Hood
records.description:
Her hood was
white, but
she never
washed it.
Now look.
records.zdescription:
Proudly wears
her
collection of
wolf skulls.

records.name: Grandma
records.description:
Wrapped in
something
that smells
awful, and
can't see a
thing.
records.zdescription:
Wants to
slurp up that
wolf's
brains.

records.name: Maid Riding Hood
records.description:
Grew up a
little, and
her clothes
got more
grown-up.
records.zdescription:
Can't forget
the thrill of
taking down
the wolf.

records.name: Red Dragon Knight
records.description:
Won't answer
unless you
call him Red
Dragon
Knight.
records.zdescription:
Attacks
screaming
"Red Terror!
RED DRAGON
KNIGHT!"

records.name: Green Dragon Knight
records.description:
Forces
everyone to
call him
Green Dragon
Knight.
records.zdescription:
Attacks
screaming
"Green
Lament! GREEN
DRAGON
KNIGHT!"

records.name: Blue Dragon Knight
records.description:
Being called
Blue Dragon
Knight makes
his whole
day.
records.zdescription:
Attacks
screaming
"Blue
Lightning!
BLUE DRAGON
KNIGHT!"

records.name: Dragon Warrior
records.description:
Wishes people
would call
him a Dragon
Knight.
records.zdescription:
Attacks
screaming "I
am the
legendary
DRAGON
KNIGHT!"

records.name: Ladies' Assault Squad
records.description:
Charges
bravely at
the enemy. At
home, too.
records.zdescription:
Enemies at
home:
eliminated.

records.name: Ladies' Defense Squad
records.description:
Defends the
rear
flawlessly.
At home, too.
records.zdescription:
The household
budget is
perfectly
defended.

records.name: Ladies' Guerrilla Squad
records.description:
Ambushes the
enemy
guerrilla-
style. At
home, too.
records.zdescription:
Utterly
defeated by
her mother-
in-law's
surprise
weekend
visit.

records.name: Ladies' Special Forces
records.description:
Specializes
in covert
ops. At home,
too.
records.zdescription:
Uses covert
ops to hide
her secret
savings.

records.name: Robo Cop Chief
records.description:
Even with a
mechanical
body, getting
shot hurts.
records.zdescription:
Was worrying
about a life
as a
machine...
then became a
zombie.

records.name: Robo Cop Captain
records.description:
In a pinch,
he fires eye
beams to
corner
criminals.
records.zdescription:
Figures it's
fine to eat
the brains of
criminals he
arrests.

records.name: Robo Cop Commissioner
records.description:
Attends
meetings day
and night to
keep his
district
safe.
records.zdescription:
Dozes off in
meetings, but
he's a
machine, so
nobody can
tell.

records.name: Robo Cop Officer
records.description:
Kids point at
him when he
stands
outside the
police box.
records.zdescription:
Worried he's
rusting while
standing
outside the
police box.

records.name: Lazy Lady Knight
records.description:
"When will
the Captain
quit?" is her
catchphrase.
records.zdescription:
Her hobby is
slowly
rusting the
Captain's
weapons.

records.name: Gloomy Lady Knight
records.description:
"Doesn't the
Captain kinda
smell?" is
her
catchphrase.
records.zdescription:
Her hobby is
putting mop
water in the
Captain's
tea.

records.name: Slovenly Lady Knight
records.description:
Spreads
rumors that
the Captain's
weapons feel
slimy.
records.zdescription:
Her hobby is
slowly
thinning the
Captain's
armor.

records.name: Lady Knight
records.description:
Desperate not
to be hated
by the
knights' girl
clique.
records.zdescription:
At the bottom
of the
knights' girl
clique.

records.name: Goddess of the Aurora
records.description:
When she
smiles her
goddess
smile,
everyone
freezes.
records.zdescription:
Believes a
goddess's job
is smiling,
so she barely
works.

records.name: Goddess of Victory
records.description:
Her devoted
nature ruins
her love
life.
records.zdescription:
Slurps
discarded
brains,
vowing to be
more devoted
to the next
guy.

records.name: Goddess of Love
records.description:
Pure
compassion,
but can't get
a boyfriend.
records.zdescription:
Figures
anyone whose
brain she's
eaten counts
as a
boyfriend.

records.name: Goddess of Fate
records.description:
Doesn't know
who her
destined
lover is.
records.zdescription:
Wanders day
and night
seeking her
true love and
tasty brains.

records.name: Kamakura Warrior
records.description:
Complains to
his retainer
once a day
about his
heavy helmet.
records.zdescription:
When he's
grumpy, he
kicks his
retainer's
shins until
he cries.

records.name: Oshu Warrior
records.description:
Beams shoot
out when he
takes off his
eyepatch.
records.zdescription:
When alone,
he plays with
eyepatches
over both
eyes.

records.name: Kai Warrior
records.description:
His wild-
haired helmet
keeps his
head warm.
records.zdescription:
Being a
zombie made
his helmet
start
shedding.

records.name: Fallen Samurai
records.description:
The
battlefield
is scary, so
he ran off
for a cafe
break.
records.zdescription:
If it's for
brains, he
feels he
could shine
on the
battlefield.

records.name: Legendary Swordsman
records.description:
Sips tea at
the cafe,
deciding who
should commit
seppuku.
records.zdescription:
Would rather
order heads
cut off than
bellies.

records.name: Master Swordsman
records.description:
Afternoon
practice is a
pain, so
he'll make
someone
commit
seppuku.
records.zdescription:
Wants to
master the
Way of the
Zombie over
the Way of
the Samurai.

records.name: Supreme Swordsman
records.description:
Orders
cowards to
commit
seppuku for
lacking
resolve.
records.zdescription:
Not wanting
brains means
you lack
zombie
resolve.

records.name: Swordsman
records.description:
Trains hard
so he won't
be ordered to
commit
seppuku.
records.zdescription:
Wonders if
eating his
captain's
brain would
get him off
the hook.

records.name: Witch of the Dark Night
records.description:
Falls off her
broom and
gets hurt 4
times a
month.
records.zdescription:
Thanks to
being a
zombie,
falling off
her broom
doesn't hurt.

records.name: Witch of the Moonlit Night
records.description:
Mostly
simmers curry
in her big
cauldron.
records.zdescription:
Sometimes
simmers brain
stew in her
big cauldron.

records.name: Witch of the Full Moon
records.description:
Magic is
tiring, so
she hasn't
used it in
over 100
years.
records.zdescription:
For brains,
she might try
magic for the
first time in
a century.

records.name: Witch of the New Moon
records.description:
Can't use
magic yet,
but calls
herself a
witch.
records.zdescription:
Became a
zombie before
becoming a
full-fledged
witch.

records.name: Rapid Train
records.description:
Platform
guide for the
rapid train.
records.zdescription:
Body-slams
any groper he
spots on the
train.

records.name: Express Train
records.description:
Platform
guide for the
express
train.
records.zdescription:
Body-slams
any
suspicious
package he
spots on the
train.

records.name: Limited Express
records.description:
Platform
guide for the
limited
express.
records.zdescription:
Body-slams
any fight he
spots on the
train.

records.name: Local Train
records.description:
Platform
guide for the
local train.
records.zdescription:
In charge of
pressing the
emergency
button for
sick
passengers.

records.name: Alice
records.description:
Wandered not
into
Wonderland,
but a
Wondercafe.
records.zdescription:
As a zombie,
the cafe tea
tastes
better.

records.name: Queen
records.description:
Lives to boss
around her
card
soldiers.
records.zdescription:
Hangs any
card soldier
who says
Alice is
cuter.

records.name: Rookie Maid
records.description:
Makes a
fortune
working
nonstop at a
tsundere maid
cafe.
records.zdescription:
Became even
more hyper-
tsundere as a
zombie.

records.name: Bunny Alice
records.description:
Anyway, she's
good friends
with Alice.
records.zdescription:
Plotting to
eat Alice
someday.

records.name: Panda Big Sister
records.description:
Always takes
the blame for
her bratty
sister.
Chronically
tired.
records.zdescription:
Looks
sluggish, but
she's
actually
motivated.

records.name: Panda Big Brother
records.description:
A super
upbeat, funky
construction
dude.
records.zdescription:
So funky
he'll crazily
eat anything.

records.name: Panda Twin (Older)
records.description:
A complaining
office lady
who grumbles
every day.
records.zdescription:
Got tired of
complaining,
so she
decided to
eat people.

records.name: Panda Twin (Younger)
records.description:
A secretary
who loves
panda and
maid cosplay.
records.zdescription:
Suddenly
wondered why
she was a
secretary, so
she got
zombified.

records.name: Super Pigsy
records.description:
A pig-faced
human who
loves to eat.
records.zdescription:
Ever since
turning, he's
always
starving.

records.name: Sun Wukong the Glutton
records.description:
A mischievous
monkey-faced
human who's
great at
sports.
records.zdescription:
Stopped
caring about
working hard
for anything.

records.name: Sandy the Swindler
records.description:
Looks tough,
but a gentle
kappa-man at
heart.
records.zdescription:
Hates
cucumbers
since
becoming a
zombie.

records.name: Monk Tripitaka the Spiteful
records.description:
A super calm,
sometimes
strict,
actually bald
monk.
records.zdescription:
Got tired of
bossing
underlings,
so he went
solo.

records.name: Bull Demon Barf
records.description:
A bull-man
whose only
strong point
is his horns.
records.zdescription:
Got tired of
grass and
started
eating meat
too.

records.name: Ashura-A
records.description:
Eldest of the
four Ashura
brothers.
Hates
complainers.
records.zdescription:
Always
targets the
complainers.

records.name: Ashura-I
records.description:
Second of the
four Ashura
brothers. A
ladies' man.
records.zdescription:
Still goes
after the
ladies, even
as a zombie.

records.name: Ashura-U
records.description:
Third of the
four Ashura
brothers.
Thinks about
nothing.
records.zdescription:
Lost his
brain, so now
he thinks
even less.

records.name: Ashura-E
records.description:
Youngest of
the Ashura
brothers.
Worries he
alone has a
robot face.
records.zdescription:
Recently
figured out
why he alone
has a robot
face.

records.name: Aladdeen
records.description:
A regular guy
who's sort of
a desert
prince, in
love with
Jasmen.
records.zdescription:
Forgot Jasmen
existed after
becoming a
zombie.

records.name: Jasmen
records.description:
A desert
princess head
